BiblicalUsage: yishrâh is the Bible's word for uprightness, rectitude. In 1 Kings 3:6, in uprightness of heart with thee.
TheologicalSignificance: David walked in uprightness of heart, and I take yishrâh as the measure Solomon asks God to remember.
